recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is recommended unless a future work group decision changes the broader performer actor policy.
issue_request: FHIR-22150 was a Published/Persuasive CDS change request for FHIR-core RiskAssessment, raised against STU3 and applied for R5, requesting that RiskAssessment.performer be expanded to allow Patient and RelatedPerson references.
initial_application: The change was applied by commit 5857d26c4ea8a408e0bbf9628ecf2feeb01f16ce, "J#22150: Add Patient and RelatedPerson to RiskAssessment.performer", which added Patient and RelatedPerson targetProfile entries and updated the performer definition text.
additional_context: RiskAssessment is active in source/fhir.ini. Current source/riskassessment/structuredefinition-RiskAssessment.xml still contains Patient and RelatedPerson target profiles, and the related Event mapping exception text reflects the updated definition. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches did not reveal a later conflicting decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current authoritative source already implements the approved expansion.
